_comment: Attention patches — MODEL-in/MODEL-out nodes chained between the diffusion-model loader and the sampler. Each is `bypassable`, so the form offers an enable/disable toggle at the top of its section and a disabled node is removed at generate time with its `model` link reconnected (for anyone without the custom node installed). Numbers and combos enrich from /object_info. BlockSparseAttention is ComfyUI core's sparse attention (it replaces the deprecated kijai SolAttnPatch, and Spectrum MiniMax H3 audits it so forecasts carry across its sparse transitions); its `method` is a DynamicCombo, so the API export stores the choice as `selection` and the chosen method's inputs as dotted keys — only `sol-attn`'s `selection.tau` is exposed, the method stays as exported (sla/vsa need trained weights). Its dense_blocks parser takes only non-negative indices ('0, 1, 47-49'; MiniMax H3 has 50 blocks, 0–49) — a '-1' would silently mean block 1. Place it after Model Attention Backend, which becomes its dense fallback. Note: KJNodes documents PathchSageAttentionKJ as a global patch that isn't undone by removing the node — run it once with `disabled` to revert.
